Our TPP focuses on improvement in bone pain and physical functioning, but we also need to capture fatigue and treatment tolerability. Please generate a full COA strategy.

## COA Measurement Strategy — Multiple Myeloma Phase 3

**In one sentence:** This trial aims to demonstrate superiority in patient-reported bone pain improvement and physical functioning preservation, while capturing the symptomatic tolerability profile of a next-generation proteasome inhibitor with step-up dosing to support regulatory labelling claims.

**Key challenge:** Capturing proteasome inhibitor-specific peripheral neuropathy without introducing measurement bias toward the experimental arm, given this class's well-documented neuropathic toxicity profile.

**Recommended starting point:** EORTC QLQ-C30 + QLQ-MY20 for regulatory precedent ([ 35 MM RCTs used EORTC QLQ-C30 as secondary/exploratory endpoints; most common instruments were EORTC QLQ-C30 (n=13) and QLQ-MY20 (n=8) ](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00277-024-06129-5)), EQ-5D-5L for HTA requirements, plus Brief Pain Inventory given PI neuropathy considerations.

**Critical gap:** Peripheral neuropathy measurement strategy — standard CTCAE may miss patient-perceived neuropathic pain that differentiates PI tolerability profiles.

## Key Observations

• **PRO positioning precedent:** [ All 35 MM RCTs had PROs as secondary or exploratory endpoints; pre-specified concept rationale provided in only one instance ](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00277-024-06129-5) — indicating regulatory acceptance of PRO endpoints but emphasizing need for strong rationale documentation in your protocol.

• **Domain prioritization:** [ Most common pre-specified domains were Global health status/QoL (90.9%), Physical Functioning (54.5%), Fatigue (54.5%), and Pain ](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00277-024-06129-5) — directly aligning with your TPP claims for bone pain and physical functioning.

• **PI-specific neuropathy consideration:** [ BIPN is increasingly recognized as a proteasome inhibitor class effect producing painful, axonal, sensory neuropathy; peripheral neuropathy with neuropathic pain represents the dose-limiting toxicity ](https://ashpublications.org/blood/article/112/5/1593/25469/Bortezomib-induced-peripheral-neuropathy-in) — requiring neuropathy-specific PRO measurement beyond standard CTCAE.

• **MID validation strength:** [ Anchor-based MIDs established for QLQ-MY20: Disease Symptoms 10 points, Side Effects 10 points, Body Image 13 points, Future Perspective 9 points ](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6852250/) — providing solid regulatory foundation for QLQ-MY20 endpoints.

• **EQ-5D mapping capability:** [ Successful mapping algorithm developed from QLQ-C30/QLQ-MY20 to EQ-5D utility in MM patients ](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4007827/) — enabling utility derivation if direct EQ-5D collection fails.

• **Assessment timing consideration:** [ Timing of assessments in trials were heterogeneous and usually sparse; experimental drug given early within cycle while backbone therapy continued ](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41408-021-00543-y) — requiring careful timing strategy around your weekly IV step-up dosing schedule.

## What the Expert Needs to Decide

1. **Neuropathy measurement strategy:** Whether to include BPI-SF or PRO-CTCAE neuropathy items to capture PI-specific tolerability differentiation beyond standard CTCAE clinician ratings.

2. **Assessment timing coordination:** Schedule alignment with weekly IV dosing and step-up protocol to capture peak symptom periods while minimizing patient burden during dose escalation.

3. **Endpoint hierarchy positioning:** Which PRO endpoint (TTD for pain, physical functioning, or global health status) to position as key secondary for alpha-controlled testing after survival endpoints.

4. **QLQ-MY20 inclusion justification:** Whether the regulatory precedent value outweighs the [ need for MM module updating for current therapy landscape ](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41408-023-00815-9) given your next-generation PI mechanism.

5. **Missing data mitigation:** Strategy for addressing the [ high rejection rate for MM PRO claims due to missing data and lack of pre-specification ] seen in regulatory reviews — requiring MMRM primary analysis with robust sensitivity analyses.
